subject.title: Add atomic claim/lease primitives for concurrent cron job dispatch and removal

question: Which public cron dispatch/removal precondition should OpenClaw support for safe concurrent job retirement?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but claim tokens, CAS remove, and documented single-flight semantics create different API, storage, exit-code, and compatibility contracts.

options.title: Add narrow CAS/remove precondition
options.body: Add a version or `--if-unclaimed` remove path with a distinct conflict result before considering a broader lease-token API.

options.title: Design full dispatch leases
options.body: Expose claim state and lease tokens through show/remove/run payloads, accepting the wider API and storage contract.

options.title: Fold into scheduler authority work
options.body: Treat this as a requirement of the broader HA or agent schedule-authority designs and defer implementation until that contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Add narrow CAS/remove precondition
recommendation.body: Add a version or `--if-unclaimed` remove path with a distinct conflict result before considering a broader lease-token API.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent cron API history in the inspected evidence and prior review context for this item.
